  FROM rangos
  GROUP BY rango_retraso
)
SELECT rango_retraso,

WITH vendedores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT oi.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS ingresos, AVG(rv.review_score) AS calificacion, 
         100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(v.order_delivered_customer_date) > julianday(v.order_estimated_delivery_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS pct_tarde
  FROM order_items oi 
  JOIN vw_pedidos_validos v ON v.order_id = oi.order_id 
  JOIN order_reviews rv ON rv.order_id = v.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
ranking AS (
  SELECT seller_id, ingresos, calificacion, pct_tarde, 
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ingresos DESC) AS ingresos_rank,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY calificacion) AS calificacion_rank,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pct_tarde) AS pct_tarde_rank
  FROM vendedores
),
top_25_ingresos AS (
  SELECT seller_id FROM ranking WHERE ingresos_rank <= 0.25
),
vendedores_filtro AS (
  SELECT seller_id, ingresos, calificacion, pct_tarde
  FROM ranking
  WHERE (calificacion_rank < 0.35 OR pct_tarde_rank > 0.15) AND seller_id IN (SELECT seller_id FROM top_25_ingresos)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS vendedores, SUM(ingresos) AS ingresos_totales
FROM vendedores_filtro
